hero.label: Made for Senso
hero.headline: I want to help Senso make enterprise knowledge actually usable for AI.
hero.subheadline: Senso is solving one of the most foundational problems in the agentic era: enterprises have enormous knowledge locked in messy systems, and AI agents can't reliably act on it. That context layer infrastructure is exactly where I want to build my career. Coming from a background in B2B sales development and digital marketing, I understand what it takes to help customers see value fast and stick around.

whyCompany.title: Senso is building the ground truth layer AI agents actually need
whyCompany.body: Most AI deployments fail not because the model is bad, but because the context fed into it is fragmented and unverified. Senso's approach of creating a machine-readable, citation-ready System of Record for enterprise knowledge is the kind of infrastructure play that wins long-term. That is a genuinely hard problem worth solving, and I want to be close to customers who are navigating it.

whyCompany.title: Eight people, YC-backed, three open sales roles right now
whyCompany.body: Senso is at the stage where the first customer success hires shape the entire post-sale culture and playbook. Founded in 2024, backed by Y Combinator, and still a team of eight, this is the moment where showing up and owning the customer relationship actually matters. I want to be the person who helps define what great looks like here.

whyCompany.title: My BDR and NextAfter work maps directly onto this customer journey
whyCompany.body: At Copygen.ai I ran cold outreach in HubSpot and LinkedIn sequences that helped land 15 to 20 paying clients, so I know how hard it is to get a customer through the door. At NextAfter I worked inside a B2B consultancy where client trust and measurable outcomes were everything. Customer success at an early-stage AI infrastructure company is where both of those experiences converge.

quote: The agentic web needs a ground truth layer, and Senso is building it. I want to be the person who makes sure every enterprise customer actually gets there.
